The '''Eidoloni system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] where [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] transported a wide range of heavy materials used for the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].

Imperial outpost [[DX-11a]] was situated there.
